42. (1) The Commission may make rules in respect of all
matters for which rules are required or authorized to be made
under  this  Act.  Every  rule  made  under  this  Act  shall  be
published in the Gazette.
(2) Every rule made by the Commission shall be approved
by the Minister and such rules and the notification of such
approval  be  published  in  the  Gazette  within  a  reasonable
period of time not exceeding three months and shall come
into  operation  on  the  date  its  publication  or  on  such  later
date as may be specified thereon.
(3) Any rule made by the Commission may at any time,
be amended, added to, varied or rescinded in the like manner.
